In [[geometry]], the '''parabiaugmented truncated dodecahedron''' is one of the [[Johnson solid]]s ({{math|''J''{{sub|69}}}}). As its name suggests, it is created by attaching two [[pentagonal cupola]]s ({{math|''J''{{sub|5}}}}) onto two parallel [[decagon]]al faces of a [[truncated dodecahedron]].
